test_title: PYST 46: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: GMUZ is related to EJSW in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, YAMN is related to WXKK. To which of the given options is SRGE related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98ff49e1304293e28ae94580d9878fd9c7d5a7fc7fac0b72202317ca673b5dc1.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, GMUZ → EJSW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8017ab16fa124000d2a2fdc6b1544b24a53d5a1d4547c419396d46655b0e22.png] 

For, YAMN → WXKK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b266240ca0efdee0bfc75324d9b2184162c614b4e3ad122903dcd4cce893c54.png] 

Now, apply the same to SRGE:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc0adc57878acd7d8a4ee9884545999fae25f50ae6e6b6c9709431ed66d2b286.png] 

So, SRGE → QOEB

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
